q: Which is an advanced capability of Hermes Agent?
explanation: Voice mode lets you talk to the agent; it transcribes, works, and replies with spoken TTS on recent models.

q: How should code execution be run to be safe?
options: Directly on your bare system at full access
In a sandbox or container (Docker) for isolation
Only on a machine you don't care about
explanation: Sandboxed/containerised execution keeps risky tasks isolated so they can't harm your real system.

q: What is the main advantage of running a local model via Ollama?
options: Smarter reasoning than any cloud model
explanation: Local models keep all interactions on-device for maximum privacy, though cloud models stay smarter for heavy reasoning.

q: For a learner on a slow connection, why does voice matter for a personal agent?
options: Voice always uses less data than text
You can issue hands-free tasks and listen to results while away from a keyboard
Voice works without any model at all
It is faster than every text reply
explanation: Voice is about convenience and hands-free use — especially useful on the go — not about saving mobile data.
